configurePresets.name: case-a
configurePresets.displayName: A: local / native dummy / Debug / tests ON
configurePresets.description: Configure local inference on every rank using native C++ dummy arithmetic. Debug build with unit and MPI tests enabled; no ONNX dependency.

configurePresets.name: case-a-onnx-debug
configurePresets.displayName: A: local / ONNX CPU / Debug (-O0 -g) / tests ON
configurePresets.description: Configure Case A with ONNX Runtime CPU, the compiler/MPI environment supplied by the user, -O0 -g, and models/dummy.onnx. The matching build preset builds only test_coupling_A and its dependencies.

configurePresets.name: case-b
configurePresets.displayName: B: MPI service / native dummy / Debug / tests ON
configurePresets.description: Configure physics clients and inference servers using native C++ dummy arithmetic. Debug build with tests enabled; defaults to one server rank per node, with dedicated server nodes selectable at runtime.

configurePresets.name: case-a-onnx
configurePresets.displayName: A: local / ONNX CPU / Debug / tests ON
configurePresets.description: Configure local ONNX Runtime CPU inference on every rank and download the pinned runtime. Enables native-reference comparison and coupling tests; MLHPC_ONNX_MODEL supplies the rho/u compatibility model.

configurePresets.name: case-b-onnx
configurePresets.displayName: B: MPI service / ONNX CPU / Debug / tests ON
configurePresets.description: Configure ONNX Runtime CPU inference on server ranks only and download the pinned runtime. Enables native-reference comparison and MPI round-trip tests; MLHPC_ONNX_MODEL supplies the rho/u compatibility model. Server placement is selected at runtime.

configurePresets.name: case-a-no-tests
configurePresets.displayName: A: local / native dummy / RelWithDebInfo / tests OFF
configurePresets.description: Configure optimized local native-dummy inference with debug symbols. Builds the application without test targets or ONNX dependencies.

configurePresets.name: case-b-no-tests
configurePresets.displayName: B: MPI service / native dummy / RelWithDebInfo / tests OFF
configurePresets.description: Configure optimized native-dummy client/server inference with debug symbols and no tests. Server placement remains a runtime choice.

configurePresets.name: case-a-onnx-no-tests
configurePresets.displayName: A: local / ONNX CPU / RelWithDebInfo / tests OFF
configurePresets.description: Configure optimized local ONNX Runtime CPU inference with debug symbols and a pinned runtime download. No tests or native-dummy reference are built; pass the model path when running the application.

configurePresets.name: case-b-onnx-no-tests
configurePresets.displayName: B: MPI service / ONNX CPU / RelWithDebInfo / tests OFF
configurePresets.description: Configure optimized server-side ONNX Runtime CPU inference with debug symbols and a pinned runtime download. No tests or native-dummy reference are built; model path and server placement are runtime inputs.

buildPresets.name: case-a
buildPresets.displayName: Build A: native dummy / application + tests / Debug
buildPresets.description: Build the application and all enabled tests in build/case-a. Does not execute tests.

buildPresets.name: case-a-onnx-debug
buildPresets.displayName: Build A: ONNX CPU / test_coupling_A only / Debug
buildPresets.description: Build only test_coupling_A and its dependencies in build/case-a-onnx-debug using two jobs. Intended for interactive stepping; does not launch the debugger or run the test.

buildPresets.name: case-b
buildPresets.displayName: Build B: native dummy / application + tests / Debug
buildPresets.description: Build the application and all enabled tests in build/case-b. Does not execute tests.

buildPresets.name: case-a-onnx
buildPresets.displayName: Build A: ONNX CPU / application + comparison tests / Debug
buildPresets.description: Build the ONNX-selected application, native reference, and all enabled tests in build/case-a-onnx. The native reference is linked into tests, not the application. Does not execute tests.

buildPresets.name: case-b-onnx
buildPresets.displayName: Build B: ONNX CPU / application + comparison tests / Debug
buildPresets.description: Build the ONNX-selected service application, native reference, and all enabled tests in build/case-b-onnx. The native reference is linked into tests, not the application. Does not execute tests.

buildPresets.name: case-a-no-tests
buildPresets.displayName: Build A: native dummy / no tests / RelWithDebInfo
buildPresets.description: Build the optimized native-dummy application and its libraries in build/case-a-no-tests. No test executables are built.

buildPresets.name: case-b-no-tests
buildPresets.displayName: Build B: native dummy / no tests / RelWithDebInfo
buildPresets.description: Build the optimized native-dummy service application and its libraries in build/case-b-no-tests. No test executables are built.

buildPresets.name: case-a-onnx-no-tests
buildPresets.displayName: Build A: ONNX CPU / no tests / RelWithDebInfo
buildPresets.description: Build the optimized ONNX application and its libraries in build/case-a-onnx-no-tests. No test executables or native-dummy implementation are built.

buildPresets.name: case-b-onnx-no-tests
buildPresets.displayName: Build B: ONNX CPU / no tests / RelWithDebInfo
buildPresets.description: Build the optimized ONNX service application and its libraries in build/case-b-onnx-no-tests. No test executables or native-dummy implementation are built.

testPresets.name: case-a-unit
testPresets.displayName: Test A: unit suite / native dummy / no MPI launcher
testPresets.description: Run tests labeled unit from build/case-a, including native dummy inference. Does not launch multiple MPI ranks.

testPresets.name: case-a-mpi
testPresets.displayName: Test A: MPI suite / local native-dummy coupling + startup
testPresets.description: Run tests labeled mpi from build/case-a using four ranks by default, including snapshot distribution, local coupling, and startup/shutdown. Use a one-node allocation; the inactive B coupling test self-skips.

testPresets.name: case-b-unit
testPresets.displayName: Test B: unit suite / native dummy / no MPI launcher
testPresets.description: Run tests labeled unit from build/case-b, including native dummy inference. Does not launch multiple MPI ranks.

testPresets.name: case-b-mpi
testPresets.displayName: Test B: MPI suite / native-dummy round-trip + startup
testPresets.description: Run tests labeled mpi from build/case-b using four ranks by default, including snapshot distribution, local-server coupling, and startup/shutdown. Use a one-node allocation; the inactive A coupling test self-skips.

testPresets.name: case-a-onnx
testPresets.displayName: Test A: ONNX vs native dummy / standalone, no MPI transport
testPresets.description: Run the standalone ONNX/native-dummy comparison from build/case-a-onnx on synthetic rho/u batches. Tests numerical agreement and input checks, not MPI communication.

testPresets.name: case-b-onnx
testPresets.displayName: Test B: ONNX vs native dummy / standalone, no MPI transport
testPresets.description: Run the standalone ONNX/native-dummy comparison from build/case-b-onnx on synthetic rho/u batches. Selecting the B build does not make this standalone test use MPI transport.

testPresets.name: case-a-onnx-mpi
testPresets.displayName: Test A: local ONNX coupling vs native reference + startup
testPresets.description: Run the active Case A coupling test and application smoke test using four ranks by default. Inference is local to each rank; the smoke test only checks startup/shutdown. Excludes snapshot distribution.

testPresets.name: case-b-onnx-mpi
testPresets.displayName: Test B: MPI ONNX round-trip vs native reference + startup
testPresets.description: Run the active Case B coupling test and application smoke test using four ranks by default. Synthetic chunks travel through real MPI to local server ranks running ONNX; clients own no engine. Excludes snapshot distribution.
